high_level_description: This image captures a stunning view of the night sky, dominated by the Milky Way galaxy. The central feature is the bright, glowing band of the galaxy, which appears to be the galactic core, radiating a vibrant purple hue. Surrounding this core are countless stars scattered across the dark expanse of space, creating a mesmerizing starfield. The setting is a clear night with no visible clouds, allowing for an unobstructed view of the celestial bodies.
